description: The new FP32 intermediate option is not supported end-to-end by GatedMLP.forward.
trigger: Construct GatedMLP with interm_dtype=torch.float32 and run forward with otherwise valid FP16 inputs.
expected_behavior: Gate/up outputs should be activated and consumed by the down projection with a compatible dtype, or the unsupported setting should be rejected before computation.
actual_behavior: Gate and up projections allocate FP32 outputs. silu_mul and gelu_mul perform no dtype checks and reinterpret their buffers as half pointers. Their kernel processes numel/2 half2 values, not numel FP32 values. The tensor remains tagged FP32 afterward. A dense down projection then fails hgemm's FP16 input check; an EXL3 down projection first performs a supported float Hadamard but subsequently fails the same FP16-input requirement in either GEMM route. No shipped model constructor enables interm_dtype, so this concerns the new opt-in setting rather than every model workflow.

verification.description: Traced gate/up dtype propagation, activation pointer casts, down projection forwarding and both GEMM input checks; inspected all model GatedMLP construction sites located by the parent-tree search.
verification.limits: No native execution; external callers were not enumerated.

verification.description: Computed activation write coverage for 128 FP32 elements: the half2 loop writes 256 bytes of a 512-byte tensor.
verification.limits: Byte-count arithmetic only, not a CUDA execution or numerical simulation.
